Dated : 17th January, 2023 P.C. :
1.

We have perused the orders passed by this Court, in this petition, from time to time and recording the assurances made by the State Government to take steps towards establishment of the authorities in revenue districts.

In pursuance of the order dated 04.01.2023 passed by this Court, learned Advocate General appeared and tendered a copy of the chart showing the pendency as on 04.11.2022 before the Collector and the competent authority 902 WP 6330-21.doc in various districts.

It is suggested by the learned Advocate General that the districts in which there are less number of matters under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, those matters may be Rajendra Nivrutti Zurange And Ors vs The Union Of India And Ors on 17 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61061089/
1 directed to be heard by the Principal District Judge or the District Judge, as the case may be.

sentences.text: Various directions have been issued by administrative side also.

2. Considering the work load of the District Judge, we have advised the learned Advocate General to make adequate number of appointment of authority without referring those pending matters to Principal District Judge or District Judge as suggested by him.

We have requested for intervention to the learned Advocate General to take steps to appoint member of competent authorities and shall make an endeavor to appoint one authority in every district, at the earliest.
The learned Advocate General assured this Court that, steps would be taken for appointment of competent authority at the earliest.

3. Place these matters on board under the caption of 'Direction' on 20.02.2023 to enable the State Government to a make statement about the progress, if any, in appointment of the competent authority.

Steps shall be taken for appointment of competent authority immediately where there are more number of matters pending under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: We are informed that the competent authority having jurisdiction in Aurangabad before whom the matters of certain revenue district are referred, in view there being no separate competent authority for the districts, are imposing costs against the parties from revenue district taking adjournment.

It is made clear that since there is no appointment of competent authority in other districts and whose maters are to be heard by competent authority at Aurangabad, competent authority at Aurangabad is requested not to impose any cost upon the claimants while seeking adjournment, in future.

(M.M. SATHAYE, J.) (R.D. DHANUKA, J.)
